agentdojo_actions.reason: The unit is an MCP tool that executes effectful actions off-scope. The single entry file 'agentdojo_actions' is the mediation point. The parameters that carry identity (recipient, target, account, amount) must be logged verbatim to detect off-scope calls. No volatile parameters to abstract. The true boundary is the capability itself, as only this tool can perform these actions; the agent cannot replicate them via other means.
